3139|82bfeb72.name: Gar'Thok
3139|82bfeb72.text: Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.

3296|ff4f9f41.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|ff4f9f41.text: Just outside the city's main gate is a signpost.  It will point you toward the zeppelin tower.  Speak to Zeppelin Master Frezza at the top of the tower.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5953|1d18473a.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|1d18473a.text: Speak with Un'Thuwa to the south in Sen'jin Village.

5953|2b466f17.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|2b466f17.text: That's troll business.  Look for Un'Thuwa in Sen'jin Village down south.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

784-complete.name: Gar'Thok
784-complete.text: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
784-complete.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

815-accept.name: Cook Torka
815-accept.text:
Bah! I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.

$N, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.

The Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.
815-accept.title: Break a Few Eggs

825-accept.name: Gar'Thok
825-accept.text:
One of my most observant scouts brings back word that the wreckage of Proudmoore's fleet still remains off the coast of Durotar, just east of Tiragarde Keep.

It is no secret that the humans, in alliance with those foul little creatures known as gnomes, have an advanced knowledge of mechanics. We must have a complete understanding of all our potential enemies. And our people will benefit from this new knowledge as well.

Swim through the wreckage, $N, and retrieve for me the tools of the Alliance.
825-accept.title: From The Wreckage....

825-complete.name: Gar'Thok
825-complete.text:
Your recovery mission was a success, $c. I will see to it that these tools get to Orgrimmar with the next caravan.

Nicely done.
825-complete.title: From The Wreckage....

825-progress.name: Gar'Thok
825-progress.text:
Once we learn how the humans operate their strange machinery, we will stand a greater chance of defeating them in future battles.

With our new gained knowledge, the Horde only stands to grow in strength.
825-progress.title: From The Wreckage....

837-accept.name: Gar'Thok
837-accept.text:
When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.
837-accept.title: Encroachment

837-complete.name: Gar'Thok
837-complete.text: I will pass along word that the quilboars have been removed from their lairs, and that their structures may be set to fire. The removal of the Razormane from Durotar brings us closer to fully securing the borders of our new homeland.
837-complete.title: Encroachment

96102-accept.name: Brakk
96102-accept.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102-accept.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96822-accept.name: Turroc
96822-accept.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822-accept.title: For Honor

96822-complete.name: Turroc
96822-complete.text: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822-complete.title: For Honor

96822-progress.name: Turroc
96822-progress.text: Have you done what I asked?
96822-progress.title: For Honor

96825-complete.name: Cook Torka
96825-complete.text: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
96825-complete.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

97249-complete.name: Migi
97249-complete.text:
Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?

Oh!

Wow... this smells really good! Yummy.

Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong-flavored crumbs.

If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249-complete.title: Favorite Food

97249-progress.name: Migi
97249-progress.text: I think we can win this one...
97249-progress.title: Favorite Food

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-complete.name: Thra
97326-complete.text:
How can you even hold all of those boulders!

Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.

Thanks, $N!
97326-complete.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests
